name: Invoice123
description: Invoice123 (Saskaita123), invoicing for Lithuania and Latvia, read-only: sales invoices with payments, payment links and PDFs, purchases, clients, products, projects, waybills, VAT rates, series and bank accounts.
instructions:
## Invoice123
This connector reads **Invoice123** (app.invoice123.com, Saskaita123 in Lithuania), the invoicing and bookkeeping service for small businesses in Lithuania and Latvia, through its REST API v1.0: sales invoices and their payments and PDFs, purchases, clients, products, projects, waybills and the reference data (series, VAT rates, banks, units, activities). It is read-only.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. In Invoice123 open the account menu (top right), **Integrations** (puzzle icon) or **Account settings > Integrations**, and install the **API** integration.
2. Click **Generate your API key**, name it and tick the permissions the AI may use, at least `invoice:index`, plus `expense:index`, `client:index`, `product:index`, `project:index` and `waybills:index` for those areas. The PDF route of invoices checks `invoice:store`, and the offer PDF `commercial:store`.
3. Paste the key into `INVOICE123_API_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.
4. Install and run `invoice123_get_company` to check the token.

**Workflow**
- Reference data first when you need ids: `invoice123_get_invoice_data` (activities, series, banks, units, VAT rates, warehouses in one call), or `invoice123_list_series`, `invoice123_list_bank_accounts`, `invoice123_list_units`, `invoice123_list_activities`, `invoice123_list_cash_registers`, `invoice123_list_email_templates`, `invoice123_list_invoice_vat_rates`.
- Sales: `invoice123_list_invoices` (filter by `status` unpaid or late for open items, `range` for a period, `client_id` for one customer), `invoice123_list_invoice_payments` to see how and when an invoice was paid (transfer, cash, card, cash register receipt), `invoice123_get_invoice_payment_link`, `invoice123_download_invoice_pdf`.
- Purchases: `invoice123_list_purchases`, `invoice123_list_purchase_types`, `invoice123_list_purchase_vat_rates`.
- Master data: `invoice123_list_clients` (customers and suppliers), `invoice123_list_products`, `invoice123_list_projects`, `invoice123_list_waybills`; offers: `invoice123_download_commercial_offer_pdf`.

**Paging**: lists return `data.result` and `data.pagination` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`); pass `page` (from 1) and `limit` (default 20) and stop at `last_page`. Date ranges are two `YYYY-MM-DD` dates joined by a comma. Amounts are strings in the invoice currency (usually EUR).

**Limits and errors**: 60 requests per minute on the Standard plan, 1,000 per hour on Business (429 above that). 401 means a wrong or deleted token; 403 means the token lacks the permission named in the tool description; purchases, waybills and offers also need their module enabled in the account.
prerequisites: An Invoice123 account with the API integration installed (Account settings > Integrations) and an API key with the read permissions the AI should use.

INVOICE123_API_TOKEN.label: API key
INVOICE123_API_TOKEN.help: Invoice123, Account settings, Integrations: install the API integration, then Generate your API key with the read permissions the AI may use.
INVOICE123_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without Bearer, spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: Invoice123 refused the API key: it is wrong or was deleted. Generate a new one under Account settings > Integrations > API.
verifyHints.403: The key works, but lacks the permission for this area (e.g. invoice:index or expense:index), or the module is not enabled. Edit the key permissions in Invoice123.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Invoice123 allows 60 requests per minute on the Standard plan. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: invoice123_get_company
tools.description: Get the company profile behind the API token (currently whether the company is VAT registered). Costs one call and needs no permission, so it is the connection check.

tools.name: invoice123_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with client, line items, VAT, totals, currency, payments and paid flag, 20 per page by default. Filter by text (number, client, product), date range, payment date range, status (paid, unpaid, partially_paid, late, draft, credit, advance, nullified...) or by client, series, project, product, activity or warehouse id. Needs the invoice:index permission.

text.description: Free text: invoice number, client name, address or code, product title or description.

range.description: Invoice dates: Date range as two YYYY-MM-DD dates joined by a comma, e.g. 2026-01-01,2026-03-31.

payment_date.description: Payment dates: Date range as two YYYY-MM-DD dates joined by a comma, e.g. 2026-01-01,2026-03-31.

issued_by.description: Name of the person who issued the invoice.

tools.name: invoice123_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments registered for one invoice: type (transfer, cash, refund, other), cash document type and receipt number, amount, date and whether the invoice is fully paid. Needs invoice:index.

tools.name: invoice123_download_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of an invoice in Lithuanian, English or Latvian; the file is handed over as an attachment. The token needs the invoice:store permission for this route.

language.description: Language of the PDF: lt (Lithuanian), en (English) or lv (Latvian).

tools.name: invoice123_get_invoice_payment_link
tools.description: Get the online payment link of an invoice, when the company has a payment provider (Montonio or Paysera) enabled. Needs invoice:index.

tools.name: invoice123_list_invoice_vat_rates
tools.description: List the VAT rates available on sales invoices: id, VAT code (e.g. PVM1), tariff in percent and the reverse-charge article where it applies.

tools.name: invoice123_get_invoice_data
tools.description: Get in one call the reference data used on invoices: activities, document series, bank accounts, units, VAT rates and warehouses, with their ids.

types.description: Only series of these types, comma-separated: simple, advance, credit, kpo, ppk, kio.

tools.name: invoice123_list_purchases
tools.description: List purchase invoices (expenses) with supplier, line items with expense type, VAT, totals, payments and paid flag. Filter by text, date range, type (simple, vat-simple, credit, vat-credit, foreign, other), status (paid, unpaid, partially_paid, late, nullified), expense type, activity, client (supplier) or project. Needs expense:index and the purchases module.

range.description: Purchase dates: Date range as two YYYY-MM-DD dates joined by a comma, e.g. 2026-01-01,2026-03-31.

client_id.description: Supplier id (suppliers are clients), from invoice123_list_clients.

tools.name: invoice123_list_purchase_vat_rates
tools.description: List the VAT rates available on purchase invoices: id, VAT code, tariff in percent and reverse-charge article.

tools.name: invoice123_list_purchase_types
tools.description: List the expense types (purchase categories) that purchase line items can carry, with their ids.

tools.name: invoice123_download_commercial_offer_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of a commercial offer (quote) in Lithuanian, English or Latvian; the file is handed over as an attachment. Needs the commercial:store permission and the commercial offers module.

language.description: Language of the PDF: lt (Lithuanian), en (English) or lv (Latvian).

tools.name: invoice123_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers and suppliers): id, name, company or personal code, client code, VAT code, address and country. Filter by name or code. Needs client:index.

code.description: Company code or personal identification number.

tools.name: invoice123_list_products
tools.description: List the product catalog: id, name, code, price, description, prime cost, type, weight and stock per warehouse. Filter by exact code. Needs product:index.

tools.name: invoice123_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with number, description, start and end dates and budget. Projects can be linked to invoices and purchases. Needs project:index.

tools.name: invoice123_list_waybills
tools.description: List waybills (delivery notes) with type, series, receiver, carrier, load and delivery dates and the linked invoice series, at most 50 per page. Needs waybills:index and the waybill module.

tools.name: invoice123_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List the company bank accounts (IBAN, bank name, code, SWIFT, default flag) that invoices show for payment.

tools.name: invoice123_list_series
tools.description: List document series (numbering ranges) with id, title and type: simple, advance, credit invoices, and the cash documents kpo, ppk, kio.

types.description: Only these types, comma-separated: simple, advance, credit, kpo, ppk, kio.

tools.name: invoice123_list_cash_registers
tools.description: List the company cash registers with register number, last receipt number and receipt pattern.

tools.name: invoice123_list_units
tools.description: List the measurement units (pcs, hours, kg...) with their ids, as used on invoice lines.

tools.name: invoice123_list_activities
tools.description: List the business activities (for individual activity accounts) with their ids, used to filter invoices and purchases.

tools.name: invoice123_list_email_templates
tools.description: List the e-mail templates the company uses to send invoices, with their ids and names.
